title: QuantumTransportEOM: symbolic equation-of-motion Green functions and fast numerical quantum transport
description: Python package coupling a SymPy-based second-quantization layer (commutators, equation-of-motion closure, mean-field truncations, Keldysh contour algebra, exact CAR engine) to a NumPy transport engine (Landauer, Meir-Wingreen, spin-resolved observables) and an exact finite-system real-time layer for two-time retarded, advanced, lesser, and greater Green functions. Includes batched linear algebra, multi-core frequency sweeps, optional CUDA GPU execution, custom models, and voltage/dephasing probes.
